summary: Route planner enforces execution-plans containment and frozen knowledge context; stale context -> refresh-knowledge-context, invalid context -> external-repair-required; validates implementation contract, plan_id, slice IDs, dependencies, reports, registry, hashes and evidence freshness; repeated failure fingerprint (count >=2) -> stop; recognizes current RED handoffs only when selector, expected failures, execution fingerprint, contract/test bytes and evidence match; supports legacy RED evidence with immutable failed observations; reuses unaffected slices only when exact projection or execution fingerprint remains current; authorization requires valid plan-state and maintainer receipt bindings, otherwise awaits authorization or requires repair; active actions resolve to validate-slice, implement, or run-slice; regression/dogfood slices validate directly; completed slices require matching exit predicate/status, current roots, candidate evidence, and staged recovery constraints; terminal completion requires validated terminal receipt; otherwise next actions are run-slice, validate-terminal, implementation-complete, or repair states; CLI requires caller quick-dev-tdd-adapter
